trade_cards.name: Short IM2609 / Long CSI1000 cash-equivalent
trade_cards.logic: IM2609 7713.6 versus CSI1000 7570.3601 = +143.24 points / +1.892%; annualized basis about 38.3% to Sep18 expiry. Price, OI and premium rose together, consistent with levered futures demand rather than short covering.
trade_cards.expression: Short 1 IM2609 (multiplier CNY200/point, notional ~CNY1.543m) and buy ~CNY1.543m Delta~1 CSI1000 total-return exposure via matched basket/TRS; ETF only after live beta/tracking calibration.
trade_cards.entry: After 09:30 wait 30-45m; start one-third only if premium remains >=1.50% and annualized >=25%, with no index-rebalance/dividend/contract-rule explanation. Add if premium remains >=1.6% after 60-90m or reaches >=2.2% without broad cash-market participation.
trade_cards.invalidation: Premium >2.8% while CSI1000 advancer share >65% and IM OI rises >10%, or hedge tracking/funding/transaction costs consume most carry.
take_profit: exit 3-5 trading days before Sep18 expiry
trade_cards.greeks: approximately Delta-neutral; Gamma/Theta/Vega near zero; basis/tracking/funding/margin risk dominates
trade_cards.max_loss: not strictly finite; if premium widens from 1.892% to 3.50%, basis MTM is about CNY24.8k per IM before tracking, funding, slippage and margin effects
trade_cards.risk_budget: trial stress loss 0.35-0.50% NAV; confirmed theme <=1.0% NAV
trade_cards.gap_risk: cash and futures legs can desynchronize overnight; margin requirements can rise abruptly

time exit after NFP if catalyst is exhausted

trade_cards.name: Brent/WTI 30-45D Call Spread
trade_cards.stage: existing triggered trade: hold; do not chase
trade_cards.expression: Maintain 35-40D / 15-20D Call Spread; new exposure only if debit <=40% of width, otherwise finite-risk Butterfly or skip.
trade_cards.entry: Add only on Brent pullback to 89-90 holding with WTI>=84.5, or on verified new physical shipping/mining/insurance disruption above Brent92.
trade_cards.invalidation: Brent<87.5 with sustained de-escalation/flow recovery, or WTI<82.5 without supply follow-through.
